\definecolor{stzPointpFill}{HTML}{FF0000}
\definecolor{stzPointpStroke}{HTML}{000000}
\definecolor{stzPointpText}{HTML}{FF0000}
\pgfdeclarelayer{stratifiedLayer0}
\pgfsetlayers{stratifiedLayer0,main}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
    line cap=round,
    line join=round
]

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Coordinates
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \coordinate (pointPoint0p0) at (0,0);

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Layered drawing commands
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    % Layer 0: stratifiedLayer0
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{stratifiedLayer0}
        %----------------------------------------
        % Codimension 2 strata: points
        %----------------------------------------
        \node[
            circle,
            inner sep=1.5pt,
            myPoint,
            fill=stzPointpFill,
            draw=stzPointpStroke,
            text=stzPointpText,
            fill opacity=1,
            draw opacity=1,
            text opacity=1,
            line width=0.4pt,
            solid,
            dash phase=0pt,
            line cap=butt,
            line join=miter
        ] at (pointPoint0p0) {APP};

    \end{pgfonlayer}

    % Codimension 0 strata: regions
    % Codimension 1 strata: curves
    % Labels

\end{tikzpicture}
